onboarding.title: How Sharity works
onboarding.subtitle: Quick overview of the full sharing timeline.

timeline.title: Full timeline overview
timeline.description: A typical item flow moves through request, approval, pickup, and return.
timeline.point1: Fosterer sends a request with dates.
timeline.point2: Owner approves, then both sides align on pickup.
timeline.point3: After use, return is proposed, approved, and confirmed.

lend.title: Share your item
lend.description: Post your item and control who can foster it.
lend.point1: Add item details, photos, and optional lease limits.
lend.point2: Review incoming requests and approve the right one.
lend.point3: Track status clearly in your timeline.

borrow.title: Request what you need
borrow.description: Find items and request them for your planned time window.
borrow.point1: Browse listings and open item details.
borrow.point2: Send a request and wait for owner approval.
borrow.point3: Propose and confirm pickup at a shared time.

return.title: Return with confidence
return.description: Closing the loop is explicit so both sides stay synced.
return.point1: Propose return time when you're done.
return.point3: Confirm returned to complete the timeline.
